# realuptime_status_page (Data Source)

Looks up one of the account's status pages by `id` or by `slug` (`GET /status-pages/{id}`, or `GET /status-pages` filtered). Typical use: find the page created at signup to publish components on it without importing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the page created at signup by its slug, then publish a check on it
# without importing the page into Terraform.
data "realuptime_status_page" "main" {
  slug = "acme"
}

resource "realuptime_status_page_component" "www" {
  status_page_id = data.realuptime_status_page.main.id
  check_id       = realuptime_check.www.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docsgen -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Status page id (UUID). Exactly one of `id` or `slug` is required.
- `slug` (String) Public slug. Exactly one of `id` or `slug` is required.

### Read-Only

- `accent_color` (String) Chrome accent `#rrggbb`, if set.
- `account_id` (String) The owning account's id.
- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain, if attached.
- `domain_status` (String) Custom-domain lifecycle: none, pending_dns, issuing, issued, error.
- `font_choice` (String) Font choice id, if set.
- `hide_branding` (Boolean) Whether the attribution is hidden (honoured on paid plans only).
- `homepage_url` (String) Logo link, if set.
- `locale` (String) Formatting locale, if set (null is en-US).
- `logo_url` (String) Logo URL, if set.
- `name` (String) Page name.
- `page_description` (String) Subtitle under the heading, if set.
- `page_title` (String) Heading shown instead of `name`, if set.
- `support_url` (String) Support link, if set.
- `theme_preset` (String) Theme preset id, if set.
